name: apple-contacts
description: Inspect and search Apple Contacts on macOS, and resolve a contact into a message-ready recipient.
long_description: Local MCP server for Apple Contacts on macOS. Uses CNContactStore by default to inspect contacts, search by name, phone, or email, fetch full contact details, and resolve a contact into a message-ready recipient before handing off to Apple Messages. Set APPLE_CONTACTS_MCP_BACKEND=applescript to select the AppleScript fallback.

contacts_safety_mode.title: Contacts safety mode
contacts_safety_mode.description: Type exactly one of: safe_readonly, safe_manage, or full_access. safe_readonly: read and search contacts only. safe_manage: also create and update contacts. full_access: also delete contacts. This bundle's default is safe_manage. Sets APPLE_CONTACTS_MCP_SAFETY_MODE.
